stories.title: Reid Wiseman, the astronaut shooting for the moon in F1 with Mercedes
summary: Yet the newest addition to the paddock is a man whose quietly spoken, understated thoughtfulness and insight are compelling.

Now part of the Mercedes team, Reid Wiseman has been to the moon and with it brings a perspective like no other.Wiseman was one of four astronauts, alongside Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen, who completed the Artemis II lunar flyby in April.

Last month Wiseman, the mission’s commander, became an ambassador for Mercedes’ F1 team, formalising a relationship that had been growing over several years, to the delight of his daughter, Katey, a fan of the newly crowned world champion, Kimi Antonelli.

stories.title: ‘When I walked for Burberry I met Kanye West’: the two lives of Bromley footballer Omar Sowunmi
summary: Full-time defender and part-time model, the 31-year-old is happy to shine a light on both sides of his dual career“I was walking down the street one day and someone came up to me and said: ‘I think you should be a model,’” the Bromley defender Omar Sowunmi says.

There are few parallels between the grind of lower-league football and Milan fashion week but the 31-year-old is adept in both worlds.Sowunmi’s dual career mixes trips to Doncaster with visits to Paris.

On Saturday Bromley travel to Reading under their new manager, Karl Robinson, as they attempt to move off the bottom of League One and the centre-back is clear where his focus lies even after his chance encounter with a model agency employee expanded his horizons.
